reviews.intro: Real reviews from customers on Which? Trusted Traders.

items.text: Kevin did some sealing works on the roof, repaired a wooden door, applied sealant to windows and fixed some leaks, removed and replaced base boards on a door and tiled an upstairs balcony. He worked quickly and quietly with no fuss. I cannot recommend Kevin highly enough.
items.label: Which? review

items.text: Kev took out the shower unit in my bathroom and installed a bath. He did a fantastic job and I'm so pleased with the result. He was punctual, friendly and efficient and did over and above the agreed work - always going the extra mile…
items.label: Which? review

items.text: We have used Kevin twice to fit our kitchen including knocking walls down, plastering, brickwork and plumbing. Did a great job both times. Will definitely use him again for more work. Very clean and tidy and friendly.
items.label: Which? review
